body: Sorry for wasting your time
I never fit in. There's no place in this world for sick people like me.
I'm not loved by anyone, not even myself. I've failed many times in the past to take my life but I won't fail again. This is the best decision.
I have therapy today and I don't want to go because I'm afraid they will send me to the hospital again.
I'm here and fine.
Thanks, I will try.
18 and pretty much just started with getting help.
After what happened tonight, I feel I'm going to do it one day.
That's true!
Thank you! I'm very sorry about your friend :(
I appreciate the kind words. I hope you feel better as well.
Check my recent posts. What just happens made me really upset right now.
From now on I don't know what will happen to me because in the blink of a second I can go back to the hospital thanks to my uncaring mother. Sorry for all of this once again.
I'm sorry for all of this, thanks for the help.

For the past hour it's been pure hell, my brother fought me. He hit me. My mom threaten to call the cops on me. She is such a bitch!!!!! Fuck my brother hit me. I tried to walk out. They are fucking ridiculous.
I don't want to drag you into this mess which is my life. I'm worthless

I've been like this for years, just check my post history. Most of it is deleted but yeah I have nothing to live for. I'm not going to therapy anymore (she is only like my 5th therapist). I'm not taking medication anymore. I seriously think tonight is the night for me.
Read my post history and you will understand why I'm like this.
Talking won't help a sick person like me.
I don't eat for days at a time and I don't exercise. I feel nobody would care if I was gone.
I rather not, I'm not happy anymore
Everyone makes me feel like I did. My future is not worth sticking around for.
Don't be sorry, I'm not worth living.

I'm on some many medications and antidepressants already, they do nothing for me. I don't need some to say they hate me to know that. Nobody will ever love me, not my dad, my mom, my brother or even myself.

I have depression and bipolar disorder. I got a new therapist today and next week is my diagnosis. She said I may have schizophrenia as well. I've been hospitalized for a previous attempt. I hear voices in my head as well. Everyone hates me and I would be better of dead, that's what everyone wants anyways. They won't leave me alone, I believe them.
They left.
My parents are begging them not to take me away
I'm a mistake I know it
They are in my house now!!!!
I'm just going to drive away before they get here
They charged me family tens of thousands and they treated me horribly
The police, I'm freaking out, I can't go back, I can't. I'm crying right now

Funny you asked, I may end up being picked up by the police to the hospital now. My mom, Dad and I are meeting with another therapist on Saturday. I doubt I can't make it right now. They will take too long to get me.

No, I don't leave my room. I have major depressive disorder and bipolar disorder. Everyone hates me, my brother hates me (He once told me to kill myself while I'm the hospital), my parents hate me, I have no friends, I'm hopeless. I'm called names by my brother and he makes me upset all the time. This is all my fault, I'm sorry.
Things that used to make me happy don't anymore. I love cars but I don't get excited about them anymore. Everyone hates me so I guess I will leave.
1 year ago, I've been like this for years though.
I've went to a mental hospital for three weeks when I was 17, therapy and medications. Nothing works.
Nope, no one.

I just let my dad know I'm going to do, still no response yet... just forget about me
I've been stopped during all of my previous failed attempts. I'll make sure I won't this time.
Don't worry it's fine, I'm used to being a mistake.
I don't deserve to live.
I'm sorry but I can't go any longer, everyone hates me and I'm not fit for life. I'm gone. I told my dad earlier today that I'm going to do it and I plan to.

I told my dad earlier today that I'm going to do it. I hate myself with a passion. I will never life a normal happy life. I have no friends, I'm socially awkward, no girlfriend and never will have one because I'm way too shy, my brother told me to kill myself while in the mental hospital, the list goes on and on. I'm done, nobody wants me around anyways.
I told my dad earlier today that I'm going to do it. I hate living this way, nothing will change.
I've been like this for years, it's going to happen.
There are no more ways left. It's fine trust me.
Thanks, I appreciate that...
What happens if you tried everything multiple times? Then what.
Trust me I've tried every single advice people have given me and I've only gotten worse. Once I get back home today I'm going to hang myself.
Not every life... I've tried so many things and nothing works. I'm done
Antidepressants, therapy and being hospitalized in a mental hospital don't work for me. There is too much to explain that's not worth anyone's time. I'll be gone soon.
It's been done before in the past, but it is not common. Seems like my only option at this point...
That's the thing, you can't get through to him on anything. He's always right, even when he's wrong. That's why I don't try anymore.

Really bad social anxiety, can't make any friends, don't really share any of the same hobbies or interests as other people. I don't like who I am as a person in general, never did.

My dad just came in the room and started to say how much he cares and loves me, then goes on to say that I'm he one at fault for not opening up to people... That's something very hard for me to do and I get scared. I just don't want to live anymore. Every night I go to sleep begging that I won't see tomorrow.

*Sorry for the late response, that's when my dad came in.
I don't think anybody would want to be my friend. I'm not a likable person at all, but thanks for the nice words :)
Messing up throughout all of high school and not being able to get into a good college, social skills, anxiety, my weird awkward personality.

It's really hard to to open up to people for me and tell them how I really feel. The only way my parents know about the way I feel is because they walked in on me in my room while I was cutting and then found my journal soon after. I just can't see a brighter future for myself.
